product_metadata.title: AQUIS Original - 100% Pure Mulberry Silk Pillowcase, Lustrous Comfort & Gentle Hydration for Skin & Hair All Night Long, 19 Momme, Ivory (20" x 30" Queen)
description: Your face and hair spend all night on a pillow—so choose a pillowcase that will lavish it with care. Our Mulberry Silk Pillowcase is simply the best gift you can give your face and hair while you sleep. Unlike traditional cotton pillowcases, which can tug and scratch—damaging hair and facial skin—our Silk Pillowcase allows your hair to glide, minimizing hair damage and frizz. Ultra-smooth & breathable surface glides beneath the skin, minimizing the risk of creases and wrinkles, while maintaining skin's natural moisture.
